rows.grounds: sandhi fusion of kuṃbhāt and bījam; seed taken from the pot
injunctive or optative prescribing ritual action

items.question: What placement is prescribed for the seed taken from the pot in relation to the deity?
premises: The seed is taken from the pot.
The deity possesses a heart as locus.
Ritual procedure prescribes placing the seed.
items.inference: The practitioner should place the seed taken from the pot in the heart of the deity.
uncertainties: Whether hṛdi refers to a physical image's heart or a visualized locus is not explicit.
items.plain_english: Having taken the seed from the pot, one should place it in the heart of the deity.
